points.description: Names the reactor as a completely mixed flow reactor (CMFR), i.e. a continuous stirred tank reactor (CSTR) / completely mixed reactor, with uniform concentration throughout. Clear synonyms such as CSTR, mixed flow reactor are accepted.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only partly right, e.g. 'mixed reactor' or 'stirred reactor' without 'completely/flow' or 'continuous', or 'batch reactor' is NOT accepted (0).

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for completely mixed flow reactor, or the synonym CSTR / continuous stirred tank reactor. Give 1 mark for a vague or incomplete name such as 'mixed reactor' or 'stirred reactor'. Give 0 for plug flow, batch or any other reactor type.
